q: 你想喝茶___咖啡？
en: Do you want tea or coffee?

q: 医生，我是吃药___打针？
en: Doctor, should I take medicine or get an injection?

q: 你今天在公司___在家？
en: Are you at the office or at home today?

q: 他是医生___护士？
en: Is he a doctor or a nurse?

q: 会议是上午开___下午开？
en: Is the meeting in the morning or in the afternoon?

q: 这份文件是你写的___小王写的？
en: Did you write this document, or did Xiao Wang?

q: 是你的头疼___肚子疼？
en: Is it your head or your stomach that hurts?

q: 你打算发邮件通知他___打电话通知他？
en: Are you going to notify him by email or by phone?

q: 你要喝冷水___热水？
en: Would you like cold water or hot water?

q: 你觉得这个问题应该先问经理___先问同事？
en: Do you think I should ask the manager first or ask a colleague first?

q: 你来我的办公室___我去你的办公室？
en: Will you come to my office, or shall I go to yours?

q: 你的感冒是昨天开始的___前天开始的？
en: Did your cold start yesterday or the day before?

q: 你们今天开会___明天开会？
en: Are you having the meeting today or tomorrow?

q: 复印机是没纸了___没电了？
en: Is the copier out of paper or out of power?

q: 你想吃苹果还是香蕉___？
en: Do you want an apple or a banana?

q: 他是经理还是同事___？
en: Is he the manager or a colleague?

q: 你坐地铁还是打车___？
en: Are you taking the subway or a taxi?

q: 我们在家开会还是去公司开会___？
en: Shall we hold the meeting at home or go to the office for it?

q: 你的咳嗽是白天重还是晚上重___？
en: Is your cough worse in the daytime or at night?

q: 你周六有空还是周日有空___？
en: Are you free on Saturday or on Sunday?

q: 你打算在办公室吃午饭还是出去吃___？
en: Are you planning to eat lunch at the office or go out for it?

q: 你喝水还是喝果汁___？
en: Will you have water or juice?

q: 你是先去医院检查还是先回家休息___？
en: Will you go to the hospital for a check-up first, or go home to rest first?

q: 你周六___周日有空吗？
en: Are you free on Saturday or Sunday?

q: 我不知道他去___不去。
en: I don't know whether he is going or not.

q: 我不知道她是经理___同事。
en: I don't know whether she is the manager or a colleague.

q: 我还没决定明天去开会___在家工作。
en: I haven't decided whether to go to the meeting tomorrow or work from home.

q: 医生问我头疼是早上疼___晚上疼。
en: The doctor asked me whether my headache is in the morning or in the evening.

q: 请告诉我你想周一开会___周二开会。
en: Please tell me whether you want the meeting on Monday or on Tuesday.

q: 我想知道这个药是饭前吃___饭后吃。
en: I want to know whether this medicine is taken before or after meals.

q: 我不确定经理是想自己参加会议___让我们去。
en: I'm not sure whether the manager wants to attend the meeting himself or have us go.

q: 他没告诉我们他是坐飞机来___坐火车来。
en: He didn't tell us whether he is coming by plane or by train.

q: 你猜他是病了___累了？
en: Do you guess he is sick or just tired?

q: 老板问我们是现在开会___吃完饭再开会。
en: The boss asked whether we should meet now or after we have eaten.

q: 我周末想在家看书___看电影。
en: This weekend I'd like to read or watch a film at home.

q: 我午饭常常吃面条___米饭。
en: For lunch I often eat noodles or rice.

q: 你可以给经理发邮件___打电话。
en: You can email the manager or call.

q: 头疼的话，你可以吃药___睡一会儿。
en: If you have a headache, you can take medicine or sleep for a while.

q: 下个月我可能去上海___北京出差。
en: Next month I may go to Shanghai or Beijing on a business trip.

q: 我们可以上午___下午把报告交给经理。
en: We can give the report to the manager in the morning or in the afternoon.

q: 如果你不舒服，可以请半天假___回家休息一下。
en: If you don't feel well, you can take half a day off or go home and rest a bit.

q: 她每天下班以后会去跑步___去游泳。
en: After work every day she goes running or swimming.

q: 吃完药以后，你可以喝茶___喝水，但是不要喝咖啡。
en: After taking the medicine you can have tea or water, but not coffee.

q: 护士说你可以明天___后天来拿药。
en: The nurse says you can come for the medicine tomorrow or the day after.

q: 雨太大了，我们___坐地铁吧。
en: The rain is too heavy; we'd better take the subway.

q: 你生病了，你___在家休息吧。
en: You're ill; you'd better rest at home.

q: 电梯坏了，我们___走楼梯吧。
en: The elevator is broken; we'd better take the stairs.

q: 太晚了，你___明天再去医院吧。
en: It's too late; you'd better go to the hospital tomorrow.

q: 我觉得___明天开会好，今天大家都太累了。
en: I think it's better to hold the meeting tomorrow; everyone is too tired today.

q: 这个药有点贵，我们___去别的药店看看吧。
en: This medicine is a bit expensive; we'd better look at other pharmacies.

q: 你的感冒还没好，你___别去上班了，在家多休息。
en: Your cold hasn't gotten better; you'd better not go to work and rest more at home.

q: 电脑太慢了，我们___换一台新的吧。
en: The computer is too slow; we'd better replace it with a new one.

q: 医生说了很多次，他___不吃药。
en: The doctor has said it many times, but he still doesn't take the medicine.

q: 我吃了药，头___很疼。
en: I took medicine and my head still hurts a lot.

q: 虽然很忙，他___去看了朋友。
en: Although he was busy, he still went to see his friend.

q: 我给他发了三封邮件，他___没回。
en: I sent him three emails and he still hasn't replied.

q: 已经下班两个小时了，经理___在办公室开会。
en: It's been two hours since work ended, and the manager is still in a meeting at the office.

q: 他每天都锻炼，可是身体___不太好。
en: He exercises every day, but his health still isn't very good.

q: ___你来还是不来，我们都要开会。
en: Whether you come or not, we are having the meeting.

q: 不管你去___不去，都告诉我一声。
en: Whether you go or not, let me know.

q: 不管身体好___不好，每年都应该体检。
en: Whether you are healthy or not, you should have a check-up every year.

q: 不管天气好还是不好，我们___去体检。
en: Whether the weather is good or not, we go for the check-up.

q: 无论大人还是小孩，医生___会认真检查。
en: Whether it is an adult or a child, the doctor examines them carefully.

q: 无论是工作日还是周末，他每天早上___去公园锻炼。
en: Whether it's a workday or the weekend, he goes to the park to exercise every morning.

q: ___大人还是孩子，都要多喝水。
en: Whether adults or children, everyone should drink more water.

src: 天晴他去上班，下雨他也去上班。
task: Say it with 不管…还是…都.

en: Will you come to my place, or shall I go to yours?
src: 你来我这儿，或者我去你那儿。
task: Turn it into a choice question with 还是.

s: 你想喝茶或者咖啡？
你去开会还是我去开会？
你想去医院还是在家休息吗？
你的头是早上疼还是晚上疼吗？
你周六或者周日有空吗？
你们先开会还是先吃饭呢？
你打算坐火车去上海还是坐飞机去上海吗？
我不知道医生今天在或者不在。
我还没决定去不去开会。
经理想知道我们明天开会或者后天开会。
我下班以后常常看书还是看电影。
你可以现在去医院，或者明天去。
我们可以周一开会还是周二开会。
外面太冷了，我们在办公室吃还是吧。
你的感冒还没好，还是在家休息吧。
他吃了三天药，咳嗽还是没好。
虽然他很累，他去还是上班了。
不管天气好还是不好，都我们去体检。
无论是医生还是护士，都要每天洗手。
不管你去和不去，我都会告诉经理。
